title: Do LLMs Capture Embodied Cognition and Cultural Variation? Cross-Linguistic Evidence from Demonstratives

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model response distributions on a multiple-choice spatial demonstratives task (proximal vs. distal, self vs. other perspective) against English and Chinese human baselines to evaluate whether models capture culturally specific egocentric vs. sociocentric communicative styles.

Testing whether multilingual LLMs adapt their pragmatic reasoning when prompted in different languages or if they default to uniform, English-centric reasoning patterns across both English and Chinese queries.
